remarks: Classic 5-bedroom Colonial in the coveted Behind the Y neighborhood-just a short walk to schools, the YMCA, and Waveny Park. With over 3,500 sq. ft. of living space, this home features a front-to-back living room with fireplace, a sun-filled dining room, and a kitchen that opens to a step-down family room with fireplace and French doors leading to the terrace and private backyard. A study with fireplace provides a quiet retreat, while the flexible layout includes an au pair or in-law suite with sitting room and separate entrance. This home also offers a lower-level playroom and attached potting shed. With great bones and a fantastic location, it offers an excellent opportunity for updates and personal touches to make it your own. With sidewalks to town, you cannot beat this location. Welcome to 44 Putnam Rd!
